parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

parameters.name: Http2
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable `HTTP/2`.

*   `open`: enables `HTTP/2`
*   `close`: disables `HTTP/2`
*   `globalConfig`: uses global configurations

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description:
The type of the protocol. Valid values:

*   `HTTP`
*   `HTTPS`

parameters.name: TlsMax
parameters.description: The maximum version of Transport Layer Security (TLS).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse add-gateway-domain --must-https true --cert-identifier 6828169-cn-hangzhou --name test.com --protocol HTTP --gateway-unique-id gw-86575c0bc9f04ecfbacb92b8e3920000 --http2 close --tls-max TLS_1.3 --tls-min TLS_1.0 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse AddGatewayDomain --region cn-hangzhou --GatewayUniqueId 'gw-86575c0bc9f04ecfbacb92b8e3920000' --Http2 close --TlsMax 'TLS_1.3' --MustHttps true --CertIdentifier '6828169-cn-hangzhou' --TlsMin 'TLS_1.0' --AcceptLanguage zh --Protocol HTTP --Name 'test.com'
